description: This file defines the ScopeRepository class which implements the OAuth2 ScopeRepositoryInterface. It provides methods to retrieve scope entities by identifier and to finalize scopes for OAuth2 grants, though currently both methods are stub implementations. The file resides within a plugin directory specific to OAuth functionality for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Implementation of the OAuth2 ScopeRepositoryInterface, providing stub methods for scope retrieval and finalization.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a scope entity by its identifier; currently returns null as scopes are not supported.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalizes an array of scope entities for a given grant type and client; currently returns an empty array.
